method.application: One Uvicorn worker and a four-connection pool. PostgreSQL role limit also four.
method.fixture: One exact 5 GiB body per stream, alternating approximately 1 KiB and 256/768 KiB payloads. Four deterministic high-entropy Base64 width cycles are reused to keep client generation outside timing.
method.timing: Concurrent chunked HTTP PUTs through the API, ending at the final HTTP 201, after commit. Fresh TRUNCATE, trigger toggle, CHECKPOINT, clean restart and validation are outside timing.
method.durability: Logged tables and TOAST, fsync, full_page_writes and synchronous_commit. After a clean PostgreSQL restart, verify receipts, counts, ordered payload SHA-256 signatures and exact stored sizes. This does not model power loss.
method.cpu: API and PostgreSQL cgroup CPU counter deltas; HTTP client process CPU during the concurrent PUTs. The low-frequency in-container sampler contributes a small amount to both cgroups.
method.memory: PostgreSQL cgroup memory.current and anon and API process RSS are sampled, not lifetime peak counters; PostgreSQL memory.current includes cache. Client RSS is process lifetime high water. PostgreSQL memory and API RSS are sampled roughly once per second.
method.wal: WAL insertion LSN delta in the isolated cluster; not compressed WAL volume on disk.
method.dispersion: Two repeats per cell with opposing on/off order. Report min, median, max, paired changes by trial, median paired change and change in cell medians.
method.verification_query_plan: Repeat 2 disabled presorted aggregates only in the untimed verification session, so the ordered SHA-256 check sorts short hashes rather than the full payload. The timed HTTP runner, fixture, settings and verification assertions stayed identical.
method.filesystem: A disposable Colima VM on the Mac. Free blocks were returned from the dedicated guest disk outside timed HTTP PUTs when required by the disk reserve.
